description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
